page.content:
Leader of the Kyoshi Warriors and Sokka's partner.

How Suki connects

  • Faction: Kyoshi Warriors — Suki leads the Kyoshi Warriors.
  • Character: Sokka — Suki fights beside Sokka and trains him as a warrior.

What is Suki?

Suki leads the Kyoshi Warriors, trains Sokka, is captured by the Fire Nation, and later fights beside the Gaang on the day of the comet.

Key threads lead to Kyoshi Warriors and Sokka.
